learning_outcomes.text: Gas turbine characteristics, able to comment on the advantages and disadvantages.
Can calculate the gas turbine cycles.
Can calculate gas turbine cycles for aircraft propulsion.
To make the design of gas turbines.

syllabus_topics: Basic Concepts: Introduction, repetition of basic thermodynamic knowledge.
Ideal Cycle Analysis: Simple cycle gas turbine (Brayton cycle) analysis, analysis of reheating gas turbine cycle.
Ideal Cycle Analysis: Analysis of reheating and recooling gas turbine cycles.
Losses in Gas Turbine Components: the difference between actual and ideal cycles. Total properties, compressor and turbine efficiencies, polytropic efficiency.
Losses in Gas Turbine Components: Pressure loss, heat exchanger efficiency, mechanical losses, specific heat exchange, the combustion efficiency
Comparative Performance of Actual Cycles: Comparative analysis of performance reheating intercooling and regeneration gas turbine cycles.
Used in aircraft gas turbine cycles: Check the performance criteria. Efficiency names: thrust efficiency, energy conversion efficiency, total efficiency, input and output efficiency in Nozzle
Used in aircraft gas turbine cycles: thermodynamic analysis of turbojet cycles, turbojet cycle optimization
Used in aircraft gas turbine cycles: thermodynamic analysis of turbofan cycles, cycle optimization of turbofan, turboprop cycles' analysis, the ways to improve of reaction force.
Gas Turbine Main Components: characteristics and comparisons of centrifugal and axial compressors, velocity triangles.
Gas Turbine Main Components: characteristics and types of combustion systems. Characteristics and comparisons of radial and axial turbines. Turbine cooling fins methods.

Gas Turbine Performance Analysis: Characteristics of gas turbine components. Altitude of the aircraft, depending on the speed and the speed of the turbine, the power output and fuel consumption characteristics of the discussion.

Gas Turbine Performance Analysis: Characteristics of gas turbine components. Altitude of the aircraft, depending on the speed and the speed of the turbine, the power output and fuel consumption characteristics of the discussion.
